title: FairRARI: A Plug and Play Framework for Fairness-Aware PageRank
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness in graph machine learning, specifically PageRank. While it mentions the Rawlsian principle of social justice to motivate one of its fairness criteria, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its core objective, but rather uses these concepts as motivation for a mathematical optimization framework.
